qa.question: Is there any document that states Backup Power for Island Street unit FT81?
qa.finding: The EIA table for September 2026 at https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx does not carry a backup power field. WPPI Energy's power supply page at https://wppienergy.org/power-supply/ lists the plant as a gas peaking plant of 52 MW but does not use the words backup power.
qa.recommendation: Leave Backup Power as no. The plant is a utility peaking plant on the grid, not a data center backup unit.
qa.note: I searched the web for the plant name and WPPI Energy and found only plant directories that repeat EIA data. I did not open the WPPI page to confirm its figure.
